scripts.dev: bun run prepare-content && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next dev --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 4321
scripts.build: bun run prepare-content && bun run test:engine && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next build && bun scripts/prepare-deploy.ts
scripts.preview:travel: TRAVEL_PREVIEW=1 bun run build && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js dev --assets .generated/travel-export --local --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 4321
scripts.check: bun run prepare-content && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next typegen && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:engine: node scripts/test-seedbed.mjs && bun scripts/test-travels.tsx && bun scripts/test-trips.tsx
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun scripts/assert-publishable.ts && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy
